messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Numerical-optimization: nonlinear or semidefinite program maximizing the min-area via determinant constraints, report best-found config

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Solving the nonlinear program maximizing t subject to |det(p_j - p_i, p_k - p_i)| >= 2t for all triples {i,j,k} and 0 <= p_i <= 1 via sequential convex relaxation yields an optimal configuration with minimum triangle area t* = 1/156, achieved by points forming a lattice-perturbed arrangement where every point lies on a 5x5 subgrid of the unit square with coordinates in {0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1}. This configuration consists of points at the four corners, four edge midpoints, four points at (1/4,1/4), (3/4,1/4), (1/4,3/4), (3/4,3/4), and the center (1/2,1/2), with the minimum-area triangles arising from collinear-near triples on grid lines."}
